bundle.description: Raw byte budget for the homepage-critical web bundle (index-*.js + __common-*.js from `expo export --platform web`). Baseline captured 2026-07-13 post-phase-2 (#4407/#4408/#4409). Bump budgetRawBytes/warnRawBytes only as an explicit, reviewed change alongside a note on why the bundle grew. 2026-09-07: the CI gate had been dead since 2026-07-13 (PR Merger merged Roadie PRs before the gate ran — see .agents/pr-merger/merge.sh GATE_CHECKS) and main drifted to 5,226,496 unnoticed, so budgetRawBytes was bumped to 5,300,000 as a stop-gap. Root cause (#7150): data/studies/index.js was imported statically from App.js and pulled all four studies datasets (~200KB raw) into index-*.js just to compute cross-links. Fixed by reading a small precomputed studyMembership.js index for those links instead — restoring budgetRawBytes to 5,141,545 and warnRawBytes to 4,907,839.

homepageRequestGraph.description: Chunk names that must never be requested on initial homepage load. These are explicitly deferred behind scroll (IntersectionObserver) in TopListsSection/AlbumArticlesSection (#4407) because of their size (albumArticles ~10MB raw, top10Lists ~830KB raw). Other lazy chunks (SoundLikeGuides, drummerComparisons, etc.) are intentionally preloaded in the background via requestIdleCallback for fast subsequent navigation and are not covered by this check.
